CAIF Appoints First CEO

Brigit Goebelbecker, who is currently Strategy Principal at the UK AI Security Institute (AISI), will be joining us as Chief Executive Officer in October 2026.

Learn more
Blogpost: 'Lessons from Recent Multi-Agent Safety Incidents'

From OpenAI and Hugging Face to the GTG-1002 Claude espionage campaign, recent safety incidents have been notably multi-agent. In today’s blogpost, our Research Strategist Will Anderson shares what these incidents imply for multi-agent safety and what challenges we will face moving forward.

Learn more
Seminar: 'When AI Agents Meet: A Blueprint for Addressing Multi-Agent AI Governance'

Hosted with the International Association for Safe and Ethical AI (IASEAI), this online discussion will explore actionable steps across the AI lifecycle to prevent and mitigate multi-agent risks.

Learn more
‘Supercooperation: The Future of AI for Democracy’ Workshop Takeaways

In our recent ICML satellite workshop in Seoul, AI researchers, democracy practitioners, and developers building AI tools explored how AI could strengthen democratic decision-making rather than undermine it.

Learn more
Blogpost: 'A Science of Cooperation Infrastructure: Enabling Rational Cooperation Among LLM Agents'

Designers of multi-agent systems need to know which infrastructure choices can support mutually beneficial outcomes between AI agents. Today's blogpost by Emanuel Tewolde introduces CoopEval, a framework for comparing cooperation mechanisms in practice, and outlines a broader research agenda for understanding when and why they work.

Learn more

The Cooperative AI Foundation is delighted to welcome Google DeepMind Distinguished Research Scientist and prominent multi-agent researcher Thore Graepel to our board of trustees.

Partnerships to Support Early-Career Researchers
